title: web client: getChatDisplayName checks chat.participants but Chat exposes contactId
description: app.js getChatDisplayName (line 403-408) checks chat.participants (an array) to look up the peer's display name. The server Chat JMAP type exposes contactId (a scalar string), not participants. participants is never set. Result: the function always falls through to the truncated-ULID fallback, so every chat shows a raw ID prefix instead of a contact name. openOrCreateChat (line 342-344) also checks ch.participants, which is always falsy, so the 'find existing chat' path is dead — every openOrCreateChat call creates a new chat. Fix: replace chat.participants lookup with contactId lookup in both functions.
